cancellation_summary: Flexible Cancellation Policy | Best in the Industry
description:
This trip is perfect for those of you who don’t have much time in San Diego but want to get out on the water. On this sail, you'll have the opportunity to get a glimpse of our beautiful city. This tour is a great option for families with younger kids.

***On our Ticketed Morning Sail, we never take more than 6 guests total. This means, you may be onboard with other individuals or couples.***
what_is_included:
**Kid-Friendly Captains!**
Funny, laid-back, and great with smaller sailors (and their grown-ups).

**Complimentary Drinks**
* Tecate, Coors Light, Budweiser, Hard Seltzer, Coke, Diet Coke, Sprite, Ginger Ale, Water Bottle, Honest Juice Boxes

**Complimentary Snacks**
* SunChips, Pop Chips, Hawaiian Kettle Chips, Rice Crips, Kind Bars, Fruit Bars

**Comfy Bean Bag  on Bow**
* Our favorite seat to spot wildlife.

**Bathroom Onboard**
* Spacious, spotless, and meticulously cleaned before and after every trip for your comfort
itinerary: Our Morning Sail takes you on an exciting journey through San Diego Bay, where every trip is a little different! Depending on the conditions, you might catch some thrilling military action, visit the lively bait barge where playful seals love to splash, and sail past iconic landmarks like the USS Midway. With so much to see, no two sails are ever the same.
check_in_details: Please check in at our sailing lounge 15-30 minutes before departure. A physical boarding pass is required to board your assigned sailboat.
special_requirements: Little sailors under 13 must follow USCG rules and wear a lifejacket—but don’t worry, we’ve got plenty of comfy, fun ones ready for them!
disclaimers:
***Public sails require a minimum of 3 guests to depart, if the minimum isn’t met, you may be asked to reschedule.***

If you have friends or family booking separately, please let us know in advance to ensure you're on the same boat; otherwise, you may be seated on different boats.
